subject: Fix CLUSTER GETSLOTMIGRATIONS reply schema (#5251)
reason: The change edits only src/commands/cluster-getslotmigrations.json, the reply-schema metadata: it renames the documented field 'link_name' to 'name' and documents the existing 'remaining_repl_size' field. The server's actual reply in clusterCommandGetSlotMigrations (cluster_migrateslots.c) already emits 'name' and 'remaining_repl_size' and is untouched; reply schemas are documentation/validation metadata not compiled into normal builds, so no runtime behaviour differs between the parent and head builds and no scenario can observe the change.
